texto: It presents the cause in the first sentence and the logical effect in the second: * * It is regnet. Deshalb bleibe ich zu Hause * * (Rain. That's why I'm staying home.)
It presents an action that occurs against any prognosis regarding the first sentence: * * It is regnet. Trotzdem gehe ich spazieren * * (Rain. I still go for a walk.)
Both connectors occupy position 1 and the conjugated verb is required in **posición 2**: **Deshalb gehe ich...**, **Trotzdem mache ich...**. You never say «deshalb ich gehe»!

frases.de: Ich war gestern sehr müde. Deshalb bin ich früh schlafen gegangen.
frases.es: Ayer estaba muy cansada. Por eso me fui a dormir temprano.
frases.en: I was really tired yesterday. That's why I went to sleep early.
analisis: deshalb bin ich früh schlafen gegangen
That's why I went to sleep early.

frases.de: Bei mir war es anders: Ich war auch müde, trotzdem habe ich noch zwei Stunden gelernt!
frases.es: En mi caso fue distinto: yo también estaba cansada, ¡aun así estudié dos horas más!
frases.en: In my case it was different: I was tired too, yet I studied two more hours!
analisis: In my case it was different.
trotzdem habe ich noch zwei Stunden gelernt

frases.de: Du bist wirklich fleißig. Deshalb schaffst du die Prüfung sicher.
frases.es: Realmente eres aplicada. Por eso aprobarás el examen con seguridad.
frases.en: You're really applied. That's why you'll pass the test for sure.
analisis: That's why you get the test.

frases.de: Danke! Trotzdem bin ich froh, wenn die Prüfung vorbei ist.
frases.es: ¡Gracias! Aun así me alegro cuando terminen los exámenes.
frases.en: Thank you! I'm still glad when the exams are over.

bloques.pregunta: What logical relationship does the «deshalb» connector express?

opciones.texto: Logical consequence with respect to the previous sentence
Concesión u oposición a pesar de un obstáculo

bloques.pregunta: What order of words does «trotzdem» require at the start of the second sentence?

opciones.texto: Verbo conjugado en segunda posición seguido del sujeto
opciones.explicacion: «Trotzdem» occupies position 1 and causes investment (Trotzdem gehe ich).

opciones.texto: Word conjugated at the absolute end of the clause
opciones.explicacion: The verb at the end is exclusive to the subordinate conjunctions.

opciones.texto: The subject should always be kept before the verb
opciones.explicacion: The direct order «trotzdem ich gehe» is incorrect in German.

bloques.frase: Ich hatte Kopfschmerzen. ___ bin ich zum Arzt gegangen.

opciones.explicacion: «Deshalb» introduces the logical consequence of being ill.
«Trotzdem» would express an opposite contrast to logic.
«Weil» is subordinate and would send the verb at the end.

bloques.frase: Es regnete den ganzen Tag. ___ sind die Kinder draußen geblieben.

opciones.explicacion: «Deshalb» would express a usual logical consequence.
«Denn» is coordinating and maintains the order subtl- verb.

bloques.frase: Es regnet. Trotzdem gehen wir spazieren.

opciones.texto: It's raining. We're still going for a walk.
opciones.explicacion: Trotzdem = still / despite that; gehen wir = we go out / go.

opciones.texto: It's raining. That's why we stay inside the house.
We went out for a walk because it's a lot of sun.

bloques.frase: Wir haben sehr viel gelernt. ___ haben wir die Prüfung bestanden.

opciones.explicacion: «Deshalb» points to the logical consequence of intense training.

bloques.frase: Es regnet. Trotzdem gehen wir spazieren
bloques.traduccion: It's raining. We still go for a walk.
bloques.explicacion: the verb goes second position after «trotzdem».

intro: The **deshalb** («So / so») and **trotzdem** («still / in spite of that») connectors join two separate sentences. Both are placed in position 1 and impose **inversión verbo-sujeto** immediately.
